jo-033t.title: Landscape: bulbous rock formations
jo-033t.summary: Near the town by Petra, the background mountains have unusual, bulbous rock formations.

jo-2zSo.title: Highway: single carriageway, sandy stretches
jo-2zSo.summary: A single-carriageway road running north to south, with long sandy stretches in the south. Some sections have overcast coverage, and near the Aqaba airport there is sunset coverage.

jo-4E7V.title: Google car: black, no antenna, no red light
jo-4E7V.summary: A black Google car with no antenna and no red brake light. No other Middle Eastern country has this car.

jo-7uVv.title: Landscape: very dry desert, sparse plants
jo-7uVv.summary: Very dry, with little vegetation and a lot of lifeless desert. Even the greenest parts look like a dry Mediterranean landscape.

jo-9qcs.title: Highway: divided, low green shrubs, Y lampposts
jo-9qcs.summary: A divided road west of Amman with low green shrubs through hills, reaching sandy land near the Dead Sea. Y-shaped lampposts tell it apart from Highway 35.

jo-Bbns.title: Landscape: dry rolling hills
jo-Bbns.summary: A dry valley of rolling hills with rounded, smooth rock and a single-lane highway through the middle, near an almost dry river.

jo-EQ0O.title: Highway: divided road through desert
jo-EQ0O.summary: The longest divided highway with coverage, mostly in desert, with rocky hills near Aqaba in the south. Highway 35, Highway 40 and Highway 80 are also divided but look different (not desert, or running east-west).

jo-FniX.title: Coverage: only far west, ends north of Jerash
jo-FniX.summary: Coverage exists only in the far west, on bigger towns and main roads. It stops just north of Jerash (the second-largest city, Irbid, has none) and in the south reaches Aqaba but not beyond.

jo-IdVo.title: Coverage: trekker in red eroded rock city
jo-IdVo.summary: Trekker coverage in an ancient rock-cut city: eroded reddish rocks, narrow gorges and groups of tourists. Not common in competitive maps, but a staple of many others, such as the default World map.

jo-KlNE.title: Coverage: hilly big city of medium apartment
jo-KlNE.summary: The capital has extensive coverage: a busy, developed, slightly hilly city mostly made of medium-sized apartment blocks.

jo-NwiC.title: Landscape: flat fields with rich red soil
jo-NwiC.summary: Flat, sometimes tilled fields with rich red soil, around a town on Highway 35 and continuing north and south of it.

jo-NzDL.title: Highway: divided valley road between big rigid
jo-NzDL.summary: A divided road in a valley with large, rigid mountains around it. Near the Aqaba turn-off the mountains flatten. It runs east to west, unlike Highway 15, which runs north to south.

jo-Ol57.title: Pole: round concrete, diagonal brace or Y tops
jo-Ol57.summary: Round concrete poles with a diagonal support or three horizontal Y-shaped tops. Also thin metal poles with two supports and three vertical coils.

jo-SxAR.title: Taxi: yellow with white bumpers
jo-SxAR.summary: In a town south of the capital, taxis are yellow with white bumpers.

jo-VL43.title: Houses: bright sandstone brick, flat roofs
jo-VL43.summary: Most buildings are bright sandstone brick with flat roofs. Similar sandstone is common in Jerusalem and the West Bank.

differs.how: Jerusalem and the West Bank also use similar sandstone

jo-VLxu.title: Road lines: yellow edges, white centre
jo-VLxu.summary: Yellow lines on the outside and white in the middle. The UAE and Israel can have this too, so check other clues.

jo-VYva.title: Landscape: long stretch of jagged mountains
jo-VYva.summary: A long line of jagged mountains on the eastern and southern side of Aqaba.

jo-gP2h.title: Chevron: white with red arrows
jo-gP2h.summary: White chevron signs with red arrows.

differs.how: Israeli chevrons are black with white arrows

jo-m8Pf.title: Landscape: Dead Sea with long flat ridge
jo-m8Pf.summary: A large body of water west of the road, with a long, flat, wide ridge on the far side. The ridge helps tell it from other lakes.

jo-oqbZ.title: Taxi: olive green top, black bottom
jo-oqbZ.summary: In the southern port city, taxis are olive green on top and black on the bottom.

jo-pOx9.title: Language: Arabic, little English on shops
jo-pOx9.summary: Arabic script (lines and dots), and most shop signs have no English.

differs.how: UAE commercial signs usually include English

jo-sTXB.title: Road: heat-buckled asphalt, warped cracks
jo-sTXB.summary: Busy roads in poor shape, where heat has buckled the asphalt into warped cracks. Road quality is generally worse than in Israel.

differs.how: Israeli roads are generally in better shape

jo-vAGv.title: Highway: divided, green hills
jo-vAGv.summary: A divided road between Amman and Jerash with hills dotted with green plants. T-shaped lampposts tell it apart from the similar Highway 40.

jo-xs0t.title: Plate: white, green strip on taxis
jo-xs0t.summary: White plates, long or short. Taxis and other commercial vehicles have a green strip on the left, found only here in the Middle East.

differs.how: UAE has long white plates too, but no green strip

jo-yMuz.title: Taxi: yellow and green
jo-yMuz.summary: Taxis in the capital are yellow and green. Taxi colours can help tell Jordanian cities apart.
